onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.readerHint: Your department’s introduction. Read at your own pace.
onboarding.loadError: Couldn’t load this. Your progress is safe.
onboarding.readFirst: Start with the department introduction. Then we’ll set up your account and explore WorkPortal together.
onboarding.setupDescription: Complete all four essentials to unlock the portal. Progress is saved. Only saved details count; blank sections stay unfinished.
onboarding.telegramRequirement: Connect your personal Telegram account to receive card updates and reminders.
onboarding.accountRequirement: Save your name, position, date of birth, and work start date. A photo and email are optional.
onboarding.resumeRequirement: Add a short introduction, at least one skill, and an education or work experience entry. Then save.
onboarding.personnelRequirement: Fill in your personnel record and save it. Include identity, birth details, nationality, education, specialty, and work history.
onboarding.saveError: Couldn’t save progress. Please try again.
onboarding.finishedBody: Open Getting started on Home to come back here.
onboarding.targetMissing: This control is unavailable in your current view. You can continue and revisit it later.
onboarding.centerDescription: A short guide to your everyday work. Revisit any chapter whenever you need it.
onboarding.joinFirst: Join a department to start onboarding.
onboarding.centerHint: Explore the real screens, try a practice project, and learn where everything belongs. Progress is saved as you go.

documents.title: Your department’s first welcome
documents.description: Any member can submit an HTML introduction. A department head previews and approves it before new members see it.
documents.name: Title
documents.fileHint: A standalone .html or .htm file, up to 2 MB. Embed local assets in the file; use HTTPS for external resources.
documents.invalid: Choose a non-empty HTML file no larger than 2 MB.
documents.submitted: Submitted. A department head can now review it.
documents.conflict: The publication changed or this action failed. The list has been refreshed; review it and try again.
documents.empty: No introduction yet. New members can still complete account setup and the portal guide.
documents.versionHint: Publishing replaces the introduction for future newcomers. People already reading keep their current version.

chapterHints.0: Account, résumé, personnel record and preferences
chapterHints.1: Start the day and get help
chapterHints.3: Try the real layout with temporary examples
chapterHints.4: Calendar, private cards and focus timer
chapterHints.6: Check in, check out and find help again

profile.title: Account details
profile.body: Keep your name, position, dates and account details current here. Your work start date is part of your saved profile.

home.title: Home
home.body: Home brings your main updates and work together. Check it when you start the day to see what needs attention.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.body: Ask about your work, find information, or get help taking action in WorkPortal. This is your main assistant for the portal. Review important answers and any proposed changes.

column.title: Your column
column.body: Click Your column to jump to your own work without searching through everyone’s cards.

collapse.title: Collapse all columns
collapse.body: This control collapses all columns. Try it to see a compact view of the team.

expand.title: Expand all columns
expand.body: The same control now expands all columns. Open them again to see the cards.

drawer.title: Card details
drawer.body: The side panel holds the description, people, dates, checklist, and discussion. Your onboarding checklist updates from completed setup and guide steps.

convert.title: Make a group project
convert.body: Make group project turns a suitable card into shared work. We are only pointing it out here. Next, try a separate practice example.

projects.title: Group projects
projects.body: Group projects bring people and individual cards together. Each person can own a card, while the project shows the shared result. Let’s practise without creating real work.

practice.title: Try a practice project
practice.body: Create an example project, add a card, and break it into checklist items.

events.title: Events
events.body: Events brings meetings and department activities together. Open an event for its time, place, participants, and details.

people.title: People
people.body: People helps you find colleagues and their professional profiles. Use it when you need to know who does what.

structure.title: Department structure
structure.body: Structure shows units and leadership. A department may have several heads; this view helps you understand the team around you.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.body: Choose checklist deliverables for the two-week cycle. A department head agrees check-in. You can then update progress and add deliverables. This guide makes no changes.

checkout.title: Check-out
checkout.body: Update each deliverable as done, pending, or blocked. A head locks checkout to save the cycle’s results. Open Progress to review earlier cycles.

finish.title: Getting started
finish.body: Getting started is always on Home. Reopen the full guide, revisit one chapter, or read your department introduction whenever you need it.

firstCard.title: Your onboarding card
firstCard.body: Open your getting-started card. Its six checklist items track your introduction, portal guide, Telegram, account details, résumé, and personnel record.

welcome.title: Get to know WorkPortal
welcome.body: See where to find your tasks, your team and your personal tools. You’ll try a sample project along the way; nothing from that example is saved.

resume.title: Résumé
resume.body: Open Résumé here to update your introduction, education, experience and skills. Colleagues see this professional profile in People.

personnel.title: Personnel record
personnel.body: This is your formal personnel information sheet. Keep it current here, preview it, and export it when needed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: This menu brings together notifications, Telegram, calendar connections and account security. Choose a section here to change its settings.

personalCalendar.title: Personal calendar
personalCalendar.body: Open Personal, then Calendar. See your own schedule and plan personal time here. This space belongs to you.

personalCards.title: Personal to-dos
personalCards.body: The second tab holds your personal cards. Capture reminders and organise your own work without adding it to the department board.

personalTimer.title: Focus timer
personalTimer.body: The focus timer alternates work sessions and breaks. Start it when you want a focused session; this walkthrough leaves the timer stopped.

peopleProfile.title: Professional profile
peopleProfile.body: Click a person to open this side panel. It brings together their contact details, education, experience and skills, with a résumé download when available.

orgChart.title: Organisation chart
orgChart.body: Open Org chart to see how units and leadership connect. Zoom or move the chart to follow a branch.

practice.title: A practice group project
practice.notice: This is a practice example. No real project, card, or notification will be created.
practice.hint0: Give your example project a short, clear name.
practice.hint1: A group project contains individual cards. Start with one card assigned to you.
practice.hint2: A checklist makes the card easier to finish. Add one concrete action.
practice.hint3: Check the item to update its checklist. Project progress comes from milestones.
practice.localOnly: Nothing is saved to the portal.
practice.projectDescription: A shared outcome, individual cards and visible progress.
practice.teammateHint: Each teammate has a section for their own assignments.
practice.discussionHint: In a real project, this tab holds the team’s discussion. Nothing is sent in practice.
practice.filesHint: Project files live here. Practice does not upload or save files.
practice.cardDescription: A card has one responsible person. Add concrete checklist steps below; completing them updates progress.

onboarding.resumeDepartment: Return to the department where you started setup
onboarding.managedItem: Updated automatically as you complete setup and the guide.
onboarding.mobileColumns: Use Your column to jump to your work. On phones, choose a person or swipe between columns. On a larger screen, Collapse all and Expand all help you scan the whole team.
onboarding.finishSection: Complete and save this section first.

resumeMissing.education: Add at least one education or work experience entry.

onboarding.mobileMenu: Open the menu to find this section.
onboarding.existingCardBody: Open a card to see its details and checklist. This walkthrough only shows the controls; your work stays unchanged.
onboarding.existingDrawerBody: The side panel holds the description, people, dates, checklist and discussion. Use it to manage an individual card.
